title: Shard Dominion
description: Late-90s C&C/Red-Alert-style RTS on Aether Prime — now with full sound (procedural SFX + music), pause/game-speed, a Campaign (Mission 1: First Light) and Skirmish vs a goal-driven AI that runs its own economy. Edge-scroll+zoom, clickable build sidebar, real sprites + terrain, radar, right-click move/attack/mine.
